full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Md. Ziaul Karim, J:- This Rule was issued, on an application under section 498 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, calling upon the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gopalgonj to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in Kotalipara Police Station. Case no. 11 dated 29-12-2007 corresponding to G.R. Case no. 117 of 2007, under section 25 of the Special-Powers Act, 1974, now pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gopalgonj. 

 3. The prosecution case put in a nutshell are that on 29-12-2007 S.I. Md. Hossain Ali, as informant lodged a first information report with the Kotalipara Police Station accusing two accused including the petitioner alleging that on the basis of a secret information he along with other Police personnel recovered 88 bags at fertilizer from the godown of accused, petitioner in presence of witnesses which he kept for smuggling. The informant himself prepared seizure list. On interrogation the accused petitioner could not provide any satisfactory answer regarding fertilizer however he produced two cash memos, "Ekota Enterprise" asto purchasing the same. Subsequently the informant arrested the accused petitioner along with accused, Shahadat Hossain proprietor of "Ekota Enterprize" of Ghagor Bazar. Hence the case. 

 6. Mr Khandokar Gulzar Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the accused petitioner supports the Rule and submits that the petitioner is the proprietor of "Southern Agro Service of Kotalipa, Gopalgonj and a Seed Dealer of the said area. He adds that the petitioner kept the fertilizer for his own use and he purchased the same from the "Ekota Enterprize" of Ghagor Bazar vide Cash Memo nos.946 and 964. He adds that the learned Session Judge without applying his judicial mind rejected the prayer for bail on 17.01-2008 in Criminal Miscellaneous Case no.03 of 2008. He lastly submits that the petitioner be enlarged on bail, there is no chance of absconsion or tampering the witnesses. 

 7. Mr. Osman Gani, the learned Assistant, Attorney General appearing for the opposite party opposes the Rule and that the Police after investigation submitted charge sheet accusing the accused petitioner and another and considering the facts and circumstances of the case the Courts below rightly refused the prayer for bail. 

 9. Ongoing to the, materials, on record, we find that the petitioner is a seed, dealer of the locality and, owner of "Southern Agro Service" of Kotalipara Upazila. It appears from the charge sheet that on 25-12-2007 and 27-12-2007, the petitioner purchased the aforesaid fertilizer from the accused Shahadat Hossain, Proprietor, of "Ekota Enterprise of Ghagor Bazar On careful scrutiny of the first information, report, charge sheet and other materials on record we find that there is no allegation against the petitioner regarding selling or buying anything for purposes of trade at a price, higher than the maximum price fixed by or under any law or, otherwise than in accordance with any law. There is also no allegation, against, the petitioner regarding stoking or storing anything in excess of the Maximum a quantity of that thing allowed to be held in stock or storage at any one time by any person by or under any law. We also find that the petitioner was arrested on 29-12-2007 and there is no immediate chance of concluding trial of the case. In view of such, facts and circumstances of the case we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
